# shipd Provider

Provision shipd projects and environments using the control-plane API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.11"
  required_providers {
    shipd = {
      source = "alasti-company/shipd"
    }
  }
}

# Set SHIPD_API_KEY to an organization-wide service-account token.
provider "shipd" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Management key or service-account token. Defaults to SHIPD_API_KEY; use an organization-wide service-account token to create projects.
- `api_url` (String) API base URL. HTTPS is required except for localhost or loopback IP addresses. Defaults to SHIPD_API_URL or https://api.useshipd.com.
- `organization_id` (String) Optional guard against using credentials for the wrong organization. Does not switch organizations. Defaults to SHIPD_ORGANIZATION_ID.
